title: Sorting usernames, any case
hints: Walk both strings with the same index and compare lowercased characters. The first position where they differ decides the answer.

Loop while `a[i] != '\0'` and the lowercased characters are equal. When the loop stops, return the difference of the two lowercased characters at `i`. If one string ended, its `'\0'` (value 0) makes it compare smaller automatically.
`size_t i = 0; while (a[i] != '\0' && tolower((unsigned char)a[i]) == tolower((unsigned char)b[i])) i++; return tolower((unsigned char)a[i]) - tolower((unsigned char)b[i]);`
